entries.en: Go take care of your mission if it's so important! Just leave me alone.
Really? You're serious? I'll upload them to your ship right away!
Please let me know when you find him.
Any news? Did you find my brother yet?
Any news on my brother yet?
But you didn't find his body, right? That means he might still be alive.
Please. You've got to keep looking. Don't give up now.
Please let me know as soon as you find Willem.
I really appreciate what you're doing for me. Please let me know as soon as you find any information on my brother.
I'm on a break.
Talk to someone else if you need anything. I've got a lot on my mind.
Hmmm... maybe you can. You're a soldier, right? You ever head out to the Traverse?
A Spectre? I heard they were thinking about letting humans into the ranks. About time.
That means you can go anywhere you want, right? Even out into the Traverse?
My brother's the captain of a ship called the Majesty. It was crossing the Traverse a few days ago when it disappeared. Just dropped right off the grid.
That usually means one of two things: they had massive mechanical failure, or they were attacked.
Privateers. Slavers. Mercs looking for an easy score. There's a lot of nasty sorts out in the Traverse.
I won't give up on my brother. Not yet. I've got the coordinates for the last transmission from his vessel.
My brother's just a small independent trader; ships like his disappear in the Traverse all the time.
Don't let the name fool you. The Majesty's just a small trading vessel. Only a handful of crew. But he kept it in good condition. I don't think mechanical failure is too likely.
But they don't have any real weapons or shields. If anyone did come after them, the Majesty'd be a sitting duck.
I can't afford to pay you anything. If I had that kind of cash, I'd have hired a recovery team to track him down already.
Maybe you could look into this as a personal favor, you know? We humans have to stick together.
I'll forward them to your ship right away. Please let me know as soon as you find him.
Then why the hell are you bothering me?
Willem's... dead? I guess I should've expected this.
When his ship dropped out of contact, I just knew. But I kept hoping he might still be alive.
Thank you for finding him. It's better to know one way or the other. That's what they say, right?
You're right. It's worse not knowing. That's what they all say, at least.
Maybe. But sometimes I think false hope is better than no hope at all.
Please excuse me. I need to go make arrangements for his funeral.
You've got those coordinates for your brother's ship?
I found the remains of the Majesty. Looks like it was hit by privateers.
I haven't found him yet.
Maybe I can help.
The Traverse is a rough place. We're out there quite a bit.
I'm not just some soldier. I'm a Spectre.
Sometimes.
Any idea why someone would attack them?
Neither one of those options leaves a lot of hope.
Isn't anyone else looking into this?
What kind of ship was it?
What's in this for me?
If your brother's still alive, I'll find him. Give me the coordinates.
Give me the coordinates.
If my mission fails, trillions of people die! I don't have time to go looking for missing traders.
I found your brother's body. His ship was attacked by privateers.
I'm sorry for your loss.
I figured you'd want to know the truth, no matter how painful.
False hope doesn't do anybody any good.
Fair enough.
I want to help you now.
I found his ship.
He's still missing.
What's wrong?
Willem's dead.
Goodbye.
More than I like.
I'm Commander Shepard.
Yes.
Attacked?
Those are both bad.
Authorities
Brother's ship
Reward
I'll do it.
I'll see what I can do.
Forget it.
This must be hard on you.
I thought you'd want to know.
You were fooling yourself.
[sigh] I hope he's okay.

The keeper scan has been uploaded to the database.
You do not have the proper keycard.
Get to the Quarian and warn her before it's too late!
Commander Shepard? Excuse me, Commander Shepard!
Commander Shepard, could I have another word with you?
Um, yes. Is there something you want?
Keepers? I've got no interest in the kee--
Don't get coy. I know what I saw.
Don't play dumb. We saw you trying to do something with the keeper.
Don't waste our time. I can see the lie on your face, salarian.
Don't lie to me! I can smell your fear a mile away.
We mean no harm. Just tell us the truth.
I... uh. I'm not so sure I should be talking to you about this.
All right. I guess it wouldn't hurt to tell you.
No. I guess it wouldn't hurt to tell you.
I'm using a small scanner to gather readings on the keepers.
So far, I've had mixed results. I find it difficult to get near the creatures.
Well, technically we're not supposed to disturb the keepers.
I don't really think my scanning disturbs them, but the authorities might disagree.
I'd like to do it more openly, but it's not really worth getting arrested over.
Trying to learn whatever I can about the keepers.
We see them working everywhere, yet we know so little about them.
I'm a scientist. I want to know what makes them tick.
So long.
Why are you so interested in the keepers?
I'm going.
Just tell me what you're doing. I'm not here to get you into trouble.
We're just talking. Is there something wrong with that?
Why were you being so secretive about it, though?
I could help you out. I'm not worried about the authorities.
What are you doing with the data once you've scanned it?
Following the keepers?
No, thanks.
Relax.
Why not?
I see.
Why the lies?
Let me help.
Why are you doing this?
Oh, it's you again. Is there something you want?
Again? (sigh) If you insist.
I'll even send a few credits your way for each unique scan.
Yes. I have much work myself.
Thanks to you, I'll finally have time to get it done.
So long. And good luck with the scanning.
Thank you.
Hmm. Well, I suppose I could use the help.
Activate it each time you see a keeper. All collected data will automatically upload to my database.
Tell me again what it is you're trying to do.
I should get going, then.
I've decided to help you out. Just tell me what I need to do.
I'll leave you alone.
Remind me what you're doing.
You need my help.
I've decided to help you.
No. Nothing.
Got it.
I don't even know who you are.
A Spectre? Well, nobody would dare stop you. All right, then.
You'll need this. It's the scanning device I developed.
Oh, fine.
I'm Commander Shepard, with the Alliance military.
My name's Shepard. I'm with Special Tactics and Reconnaissance.
If you don't want my help, just forget it.
I'm with the Alliance.
I'm a Spectre.
Forget this.
Not interested.
Hmm. Not enough data yet.
Why won't it move on? It's just standing there.
I wonder if it knows what I'm doing?
Just a few more scans and I'll know for sure.
Please do not disturb the keepers.
What? Oh. No. I wasn't-- Never mind.
That guy's up to something.
What guy?
The one over by the keeper.
I'm Emily Wong. I'm an investigative journalist working here on the Citadel. Could I have a moment of your time?
I don't want an interview. I'm looking for information.
I've been hunting for evidence of corruption and organized crime on the Citadel, but there are places I can't go.
I was hoping you might share anything you find during your own investigation. I can make it worth your time.
I'm a good journalist, Commander Shepard. Word gets around.
You wouldn't be investigating if it weren't big. And if it's big, it's something I'd like to hear about.
I'm using every source I can find, but I think I've got a better shot with you.
According to your file, you survived back on Akuze when everyone else in your squad got killed.
If anyone can find the worst elements of the Citadel and live to tell about it, it's you.
I've read your file. If anyone is going to uncover corruption here, it's the hero of the Skyllian Blitz.
I read about the Siege of Torfan. Sending your men to their deaths, shooting slavers as they tried to surrender...
I need someone who isn't afraid to get their hands dirty, someone who'll do what needs to be done. That's you.
Thank you, Commander. You won't regret it.
I don't have time to give interviews, Ms. Wong.
What do you need?
How do you know I'm investigating anything here on the Citadel?
How do you know that my investigation is going to uncover anything you need?
You've got to have access to better sources. Why contact me?
Sounds like a good cause. If I find any information, it's yours.
No promises, but if I find anything relating to your case, I'll inform you.
I'm here to do my job, not yours. Goodbye, Ms. Wong.
Of course.
No.
What is it?
Source of information
How investigations are linked
Why me
Consider it done.
We'll see.
Not a chance.
I know you didn't want to help, but you've taken down Fist.
Word on the street is that you've been busy. Congratulations on taking down Fist.
I was sure he was a big player in anything going on here. Did you find anything in his office that could help me?
I'm Emily Wong. I'm a journalist investigating corruption on the Citadel.
You recently took down a man named Fist, reportedly a member of some sort of organized crime ring.
Did you find any evidence in his office? Is there anything you can share with me?
I'm sorry you feel that way, Commander. I'd hoped you'd see the benefit of working with the press.
I won't trouble you any further.
You've got Fist's files? This could be even bigger than I'd hoped!
Here, Commander. For your trouble.
I didn't tell you to kill Fist!
But you're right. I suppose that I did ask you to help me, so... Here. This should be more than adequate.
Exclusive? You talk to me before you talk to anyone else?
That would be worth quite a bit, and I'd be very happy to compensate you accordingly. Here you are.
Thank you, Commander. I'll certainly let you know if I find out anything that helps you.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I should go see what's on these disks.
Nothing I intend to share with the press. These are for an official investigation.
These OSDs might have the information you're looking for.
I had to kill people for these disks. They're worth more than you're offering.
What would my future cooperation be worth? Say, an interview when my investigation is over?
Pleasure doing business with you.
People need to hear this story. I'm glad I could help.
Would these help?
No.
Would these help?
I found some disks.
Fine.
You owe me more.
I can offer more.
No problem.
It was no trouble.
I'm already getting readings. This is going to make a great story!
Thank you so much for your help! Here, this is everything I've got from my publisher's budget.
I appreciate your support. I hope this will save some lives in the long run.
Of course, Commander Shepard. I won't trouble you any further.
Thank you again for your help. I'm going to go show this to my publisher!
Hello again. Is there a problem? I'm not detecting any signals from the bug yet.
In the space traffic control room, ideally on a terminal that gives me a good view of the room.
But I never got a signal! They couldn't have found it that quickly!
I guess they've had other people try to get inside before. I should have considered that.
No! No, of course not.
Here. This is what I was going to pay you. Thanks for trying, anyway.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I should go talk to my publishers about finding another story.
Why not? The controllers need someone to tell their story, and the public deserves to know!
No! The last thing I want is for experienced controllers replaced with inexperienced ones!
No, of course not! I'm trying to protect public safety. I'm trying to help people!
I'll have to rethink this story. Maybe if I sell it as tough workers in a thankless job, they'd give me an interview.
Here. Thanks for investigating, and for the new information. I'm going to talk to my publisher.
Hello again, Commander! I've got a proposition for you.
Since you helped me get information on the crime syndicate, I've gotten a lot more backing from my publishers.
I'm investigating traffic controller conditions now, and I wondered if you could help.
Actually, in a way, it's more important. This isn't about people getting rich. This is about safety.
I've heard rumors that the space traffic controllers are overworked to a dangerous degree.
I can't get into the control room, but you could. If you planted a bug inside, I could crack the story.
There's a difference between overworked and dangerous.
Traffic at the Citadel has increased by 300% in the last century, but traffic controller resources haven't kept up.
We already have several last-minute wave-offs per week. Do we have to wait for a full-blown disaster?
Ideally, there will be calls to improve working conditions by hiring more controllers and upgrading systems.
The Council won't pay for improvements voluntarily. This story will provide that pressure.
Just audio and video. I'm not trying to tap into the traffic control system, if that's what you're worried about.
I just need to hear and see them in order to correlate their activity with traffic efficiency.
Absolutely not. I made certain that the frequencies it uses won't interfere with anything.
Excellent. Just place it on a terminal with a good view of the area.
Thank you again for your help. In the long run, this story is going to save lives.
Of course, Commander. I apologize for bothering you.
It was no problem. Good luck with your story. It deserves to be heard.
I did this as a favor, Ms. Wong. You're on your own now.
Could you tell me where you want me to plant the bug again?
I'll let you know when it's done. Goodbye.
I planted the bug. If you aren't getting a signal, they must have found it.
They must have. Their security must be tighter than you thought.
Are you calling me a liar?
I'm not going to plant this bug. This isn't a good idea.
If you publish this, controllers will just be fired and replaced. Do you want that?
It's all under control. Were you truly concerned, or just digging for ratings?
That seems like a step down from wide-scale corruption.
What do you want me to do?
Everyone knows space traffic controllers are overworked. How is this news?
If you crack this story, what's likely to happen?
What will this bug allow you to pick up?
This bug you want me to plant -- could it interfere with traffic signals?
I can't promise anything, but I'll see what I can do. Give me the bug.
I'm trying to solve real problems, Ms. Wong. I don't have time for this! Goodbye.
It's a good cause.
You're welcome.
This was the last time.
Where do you want it?
I'll talk to you later.
[LIE] I already did it.
I've changed my mind.
Don't hold your breath.
I'll work on it.
Don't hold your breath.
I'll work on it.
They're smart.
What else could it be?
It's the truth.
You'll ruin their lives.
This story won't help.
There is no story.
Traffic controllers?
What kind of help?
No. Goodbye.
Importance of story
Results of story
Function of bug
Danger of bug
I'll try.
We'll see.
We'll see.
We'll see.
We'll see.
We'll see.
I see, Commander. I apologize.
Don't be ridiculous. The volus won't be joining the Council for years.
I'm not so sure. The humans are making a strong push and you can bet the volus will be right on their coattails if they succeed.
Allowing the humans to join is a sound strategic move, but the volus?  No, the hanar are likely to be next, then the elcor.
You may be right. Though the hanar need to lighten up a bit first.
You just don't like them because you have trouble understanding them.
Maybe, but I wouldn't believe everything you hear.
But that's just it. I'm hearing it everywhere. It's not just isolated rumors.
Do you really think Saren could be involved in something like that without the Council knowing it?
Maybe the Council does know. Everyone already assumes he's just doing their dirty work.
That's dangerous talk. I'd be careful who you mention that to.
I know. But if it's true, shouldn't we be doing something about it?
No, and I'll thank you to keep me out of it if you do.
Saren's hiding something! Give me more time. Stall them.
Stall the Council? Don't be ridiculous! Your investigation is over, Garrus.
Commander Shepard? Garrus Vakarian. I was the officer in charge of the C-Sec investigation into Saren.
That was Executor Pallin, head of Citadel Security. My boss. He'll be presenting my findings on Saren to the Council.
I don't trust him. Something about him rubs me the wrong way.
But he's a Spectre; everything he touches is classified. I can't find any hard evidence.
Saren's a Spectre. Most of his activities are classified. I couldn't find anything solid.
But I know he's up to something. Like you humans say, I feel it in my gut.
I think the Council's ready for us, Commander.
Good luck, Shepard. Maybe they'll listen to you.
You don't want to keep the Council waiting.
Who were you just talking to?
Sounds like you really want to bring him down.
Sounds like you came up empty.
Come across anything I should know about?
Who was that?
You don't like Saren.
You blew it.
What did you find?
Congratulations on becoming the first human Spectre, Commander. I'm certain you'll be up to the challenge.
Commander. Any luck finding my recon group?
Well. I'll let you get to it, then.
One of my crews found him. Frozen stiff on board a derelict vessel.
The missing recon group, the one I sent you to find. They were scouting the system we found Banes' ship in.
Commander. Is there something you need? If not, I've got some things I need to take care of.
My name is Admiral Kahoku. It's about time the Alliance got one of our own in with the Spectres. We need people like you to deal with our... problems.
I'm getting stonewalled by bureaucratic assholes. Nothing new.
Maybe you can help me, Shepard. One of my recon teams was investigating some strange activity out in the Traverse.
Not as much as I'd like to.
I sent a recon group to investigate the system where we found his body.
We lost contact yesterday. Now I can't get clearance to check it out - suddenly it's a restricted area.
I appreciate that, Commander. I was running out of options.
Well, that's more than most will commit to.
I'm going to stay here and see if I can find anything out through official channels. Won't hold my breath, though.
I'll upload the info on where my team was last seen to your ship. Maybe you can get some answers.
Commander.
Commander.
I'm just waiting for someone, Commander.
Come and see me later, Commander. I'm busy right now.
Not now, Commander.
Not yet, Admiral.
Captain Anderson said you had information on Banes.
You should have mentioned this earlier, Admiral.
I appreciate that.
Is something wrong, Admiral?
Captain Anderson said you'd have information on Banes.
I'll find them, Admiral.
I'll look for them if I have time.
I have to go, Admiral.
No.
Banes.
Why didn't you tell me?
Thank you.
Problems
Banes
Goodbye.
Don't worry.
Okay.
We'll see.
Commander Shepard, isn't it? My name is Admiral Kahoku. Is there something I can do for you?
Commander. Any word on my missing men?
I'm a senior officer with the Alliance. I knew about your candidacy before the Normandy was sent to Eden Prime.
Yes - that's right. They went missing a few days ago. I've been trying to find out what happened to them, but I keep getting the run around from Alliance brass.
Do you know something about this, Commander?
A... a thresher maw? That's not... my men wouldn't just stumble into a thresher nest! Not the entire unit!
Damn it! I had a bad feeling about this ever since my team disappeared. An Alliance beacon used as bait, my unit wiped out... and nobody seems to know anything about it!
Commander, I appreciate what you did. Now I need to do my part. The families of those marines deserve to know why they died.
Not right now, Shepard. But I'll let you know as soon as I find something out.
I will, Shepard. I'll let you know when I find anything out.
You've already done enough, Shepard. The rest is up to me.
Banes is already dead. It's too late for him. I'm only concerned about my team. Someone has to find them.
Please, Shepard. I'm counting on you.
But that doesn't apply to you, Shepard. Spectres can go anywhere they want. You could find out why my team dropped out of contact.
Sorry, I don't think we've met.
Who told you I was a Spectre?
You sent a recon team out into the Artemis Tau cluster?
I'm not sure how to tell you this, Admiral. Your men were killed by a thresher maw.
They were killed by a thresher maw.
I found them. What was left of them. They ran into a thresher maw.
Somebody lured them there with an Alliance distress beacon. Placed it perfectly so they'd land right beside the thresher nest.
Anything you need from me?
I hope you find what you're after, Admiral.
I don't have time for this.
I found your men.
I'm sorry.
I've got bad news.
They're dead.
It wasn't their fault.
They were set up.
It was a trap.
Can I help?
Good luck.
Not my problem.
Who are you?
How do you know about that?
Don't worry.
I'm on it.
No. I'm waiting to speak with one of the Councilor's assistants.
No. I just want to ask a couple of questions.
No. I haven't spoken to him before. This is the first time I've requested an audience.
Yeah, I'll wait. Doesn't seem like I have much choice.
Yes. I'm still waiting.
